description.title: תביעות - מכלול
description.summary: This table outlines the process for submitting claims and providing information to the insurer, מכלול. It details the requirements for notifying the insurer of an insured event and cooperating with their investigation.
description.embed_passage: פוליסת מכלול מחייבת את המבוטח להודיע למבטח על קרות אירוע ביטוחי מיד לאחר שנודע לו, וכן לספק מידע ומסמכים נדרשים להבהרת אחריות המבטח. אי מילוי חובות אלו עלול להפחית משמעותית את הפיצוי. טופס תביעה יסופק על ידי המבטח לפי דרישה.
notable_values: Notification timing: immediately after learning of the event
Information provision: within a reasonable time
Cooperation: assist insurer to obtain documents

9.8.2 Any claim by the insured for indemnification, as well as for the payment of insurance benefits under the policy, will be submitted by means of a claim form which the insurer will provide to the insured at its request.
9.8.3 The insured or beneficiary as the case may be, shall provide the insurer within a reasonable time after being requested to do so - the information and documents required to clarify the liability and its extent, and if same are not in its possession it shall assist the insurer to obtain same to the best of its ability.
